brief: make a website for my aunt's flower shop called Petal & Stem in Jaipur. people should see the bouquets with prices, order one for delivery, and know the shop timings and where it is
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Which bouquets should the site show, and what is the price of each in rupees? You can paste a list, and a photo for each if you have them.
What are the shop's address and opening hours (including any closed day), and what phone number should visitors see?
How should a customer place a delivery order on the site?
Which parts of Jaipur does the shop deliver to, is there a delivery charge, and how do customers pay (for example cash on delivery, UPI)?
questions_to_user.answer:
Address: 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001. Phone: +91 141 400 5566.
Timings: 9am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sunday.
Bouquets: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499.
Delivery: same day inside Jaipur if ordered before 4pm, ₹99 delivery charge. Orders go to WhatsApp +91 98290 11223, pay on delivery.
Photos: not yet, leave empty spots for now.

done_when.criterion: The page shows the name Petal & Stem and mentions Jaipur
The page lists exactly these five bouquets with these prices: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499
Each bouquet card has an empty photo spot (a visible placeholder area) ready for a photo to be added later
An order form has fields for bouquet choice (the five bouquets), customer name, customer phone number and delivery address, and refuses to submit while any of them is empty
Submitting the form opens a WhatsApp link to 919829011223 with the chosen bouquet, name, phone number and address filled into the message
The page states: same day delivery inside Jaipur for orders placed before 4pm, ₹99 delivery charge, pay on delivery
The page states opening hours of 9am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday, and closed on Sunday
The page shows the address 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001 and the phone number +91 141 400 5566, with the phone number as a tap-to-call link
The page has a link or embedded map that points to the shop's address
The file has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, no broken in-page links, and no placeholder wording such as lorem ipsum or 'to be confirmed'
